Corollary
[torsion-freeness of the fundamental group]

Source: petersen:page-0261 ↗ thm:pet-ch6-cartan-fixed-point 1. ch6:6.2.4If $(M,g)$ is a complete Riemannian manifold of nonpositive curvature, then $\pi _1(M)$ is torsion free: every nontrivial element has infinite order.
Proof

↗ thm:pet-ch6-cartan-fixed-point \sketch A finite-order deck transformation of the nonpositive-curvature universal cover has a fixed point by Cartan, contradicting the free deck action; hence $\pi _1(M)$ is torsion free.

□
